    Infer rhythm-state modules

    infer_rhythm_module.Rd

    This function assigns genes to rhythm-state modules based on two-group gene-level rhythmic parameter estimates.

    infer_rhythm_module(
  param_wide,
  compare_by = "condition",
  group1,
  group2,
  tau_q = 0.05,
  tau_A = 0.25,
  tau_dA = 1,
  tau_dphi = pi/6,
  out_dir = NULL,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    param_wide

    A wide-format data.frame returned by infer_gene_param().

    compare_by

    Comparison variable name. Defaults to "condition".

    group1

    The first group used for comparison.

    group2

    The second group used for comparison.

    tau_q

    FDR threshold for significant rhythmicity. Defaults to 0.05.

    tau_A

    Minimum rhythmic amplitude threshold. Defaults to 0.25.

    tau_dA

    Log2 amplitude-ratio threshold. Defaults to 1.00.

    tau_dphi

    Phase-shift threshold in radians. Defaults to pi / 6.

    out_dir

    Output directory for result tables. If NULL, no files are written. Defaults to NULL.

    Verbose

    Logical; if TRUE, progress messages are printed.

    Value

    A list containing rhythm-state module assignment results and module summaries. The main components are module_result and module_summary.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

cell_use <- srb_example_data$meta$celltype == "1"

res_param <- infer_gene_param(
  count = srb_example_data$Count[, cell_use, drop = FALSE],
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta[cell_use, , drop = FALSE],
  theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred[cell_use],
  r_cell = res_phase$r_cell[cell_use],
  strata_by = "condition",
  B = 5,
  n_worker = 1,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

res_module <- infer_rhythm_module(
  param_wide = res_param$param_wide,
  compare_by = "condition",
  group1 = "A",
  group2 = "B",
  Verbose = FALSE
)

head(res_module$module_result)
} # }
